$comment: JARVIS Tool Capability Registry — source of truth for what CLI/MCP/plugin tools JARVIS may use. Per-platform enabled_by_default is authoritative; runtime query is automated.

tools.label: Context7 — authoritative library docs
tools.purpose: Pin docs to stable library ID; pull current content with pinned-docs guardrail.

security.notes: npm package ctx7 (lowercase). Upstash cloud: library resolution + docs use Upstash server; no keys needed for public content. No local file writes by CLI. No shell-eval risk.

tools.label: Playwright CLI — authoritative browser and test automation
tools.install: npm install --save-dev @playwright/cli && npx playwright install chromium
tools.purpose: Browser automation: navigate, click, fill, screenshot, snapshot, form testing. Single-window, silent navigation, human-mirroring cursor.

verification.note: Playwright CLI package (@playwright/cli) version. Browsers: playwright@1.63.0 (chromium/firefox/webkit) via npx playwright --version.

security.notes: Single-window headless automation. Anti-bot tested against GeeTest; acceptable for QA. Browser data isolated per session. Clicks are lightweight; test tiny before production.
security.network_calls: Playwright installed browsers fetch from CDN; each browser test is local after download.
security.browsers: Chromium, Firefox, WebKit stored in %LOCALAPPDATA%\ms-playwright (PC) or ~/.cache/ms-playwright (Linux)

tools.project_installs_when_missing: npm ci && npx playwright install chromium
